turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
I didn't come here for compliments. What do you have on Owen's essay?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Write your own email, Hale. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No. Was anyone going to speak to Owen before that mark went in, or after?
